• Bachelor's or University degree in a related field of study or an equivalent 5+ years of related work experience required.

• Hands-on experience with configuration and troubleshooting of Cisco ASA/Firepower and Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center, Fortinet FortiGate Firewalls and Fortinet Product Suite including Fortinet Access-Points and Fortinet Switches.
• Experience with Cisco Routers and Switches; exposure to Cisco Nexus Switches preferred.

Working across Product, Software Architecture, Hardware, Calibrations, System Safety, Validation and Field Application Engineering, you’ll help deliver safe, efficient and consistent integrations while preserving a scalable core product architecture.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Define and manage the technical architecture for customer vehicle integrations, focusing on the interfaces between Wayve software and OEM or Tier 1 systems.

- Partner with Product Management to translate product requirements and customer program needs into clear, actionable technical specifications.

- Turn ambiguous customer discussions into explicit ownership boundaries, interface contracts, assumptions, dependencies and open technical decisions.

- Work with Software Architects to assess feasibility and align customer integration needs with Wayve’s core architecture.

- Coordinate with Validation Engineers to define integration test requirements and ensure requirements are verifiable.

- Represent Wayve in OEM and Tier 1 technical discussions, keeping internal teams and external partners aligned on architecture, integration plans and technical risks.

- Software-vehicle interfaces: Define how Wayve’s AI Driver connects with vehicle platforms, including sensors, signals, middleware, ECU constraints, real-time execution, diagnostics and data logging.

- Integration boundaries and ownership: Establish what is Wayve-owned, partner-owned, jointly defined or out of scope, making responsibilities and dependencies clear across each customer program.

- Scalable customer integrations: Address customer-specific needs without unnecessarily fragmenting Wayve’s core product architecture.

- Technical specifications and documentation: Develop interface specifications, integration guides, architecture diagrams, ownership boundary definitions and decision records.

- Validation-ready architecture: Translate integration needs and safety assumptions into clear requirements that can be tested and verified.

- Program planning and risk management: Identify integration complexity, technical gaps, dependencies, risks and required partner deliverables to support realistic planning and informed decisions.
